extracted.intended_audience: Investigators and institutional grant administrators preparing NIH PHS 398 research grant applications (biosketches and Research & Related budgets).
extracted.subtask_description: Completing the NIH PHS 398 (PHS 398/2590) biographical sketch, Research & Related budget (Sections A–K), and budget justification for an NIH research grant application. Includes listing professional appointments, publications, current/completed research support, and populating budget line-items and effort percent descriptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — professional appointments and positions
rubrics_metrics.description: List professional appointments/positions (institution, department, dates) for the Senior/Key Person (e.g., Visiting Scientist, Senior Research Scientist, Founder and Director, Principal Scientist, Scientific Director).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document shows chronological career entries (institutes, roles, years) as part of the Biographical Sketch (PHS 398/2590). Use full institutional names, department/lab, and inclusive dates; present senior/key person's current title(s) and past relevant positions to demonstrate expertise and leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — publications and patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide selected peer-reviewed publications and patents authored by the Senior/Key Person (full citations and patent numbers/titles/issue dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include full citations (authors, article title, journal, volume(issue), pages, year) and patents with US patent numbers, titles, issue dates, and patent applications. Include a representative list of key recent and relevant publications and patents to demonstrate productivity and relevance to the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — abstracts, posters, and presentations
rubrics_metrics.description: List selected abstracts, poster presentations, and oral presentations (conference name, year, title, location) relevant to the applicant's expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The chunk provides many examples (poster and oral presentation listings with conference names and dates). Include key conference presentations that show dissemination of related work and engagement with the research community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support (Current and Completed) — required elements
rubrics_metrics.description: For each Current or Completed grant/contract include: grant number, project title, funding agency, performance period, role (PI/Co-I/Project Scientist), and a brief summary of the work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples in the page: Grant No., Title, Agency, Performance Period, Role and brief Summary (1–2 sentences). Distinguish current (active) support from completed; include role and concise description of aims or contribution to demonstrate capacity and avoid overlap/conflicts with the proposed project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Section A & B (Senior/Key Person fields)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each Senior/Key Person record: Project Role, Base Salary, Fringe Benefits, Funds Requested, Academic Months, Calendar Months, Requested Salary, and Number of Personnel as applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The RESEARCH & RELATED Budget Section A & B form fields must be completed for Senior/Key Persons. The form shows totals for all Senior/Key Persons and allows entry of additional Senior Key Persons. Ensure effort (academic/cal months) and percent effort align with the Budget Justification narrative (e.g., '60% effort (7.2 cm)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Other Personnel (categories and totals)
rubrics_metrics.description: List Other Personnel by category (Postdoctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical, Research Associates, QA Associate, MFG Associate, etc.), with number of personnel, requested salary, academic months, calendar months and totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Populate counts and salary requests for each personnel category; include totals for 'Total Number Other Personnel' and 'Total Salary, Wages and Fringe Benefits (A+B)'. Use consistent months/effort units and ensure personnel costs tie to the Budget Justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Section C Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items and dollar amounts for each item exceeding $5,000, and report the total funds requested for all equipment listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide itemized equipment descriptions and costs (each >$5,000) and compute total equipment funds requested in Section C. Use clear line-item entries to justify major capital purchases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Section D Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico, and U.S. possessions), Foreign Travel Costs, and the Total Travel Cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate domestic and foreign travel lines and give totals. Ensure travel entries reflect project needs (e.g., collaborator meetings, conferences) and are justified in the Budget Justification if significant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Section E Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Participant/Trainee Support Costs including Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, Number of Participants/Trainees, and the Total Participant/Trainee Support Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the project includes participants or trainees, itemize participant support separately from research salaries. Provide counts and per-participant amounts and compute totals; these are reported distinct from other direct costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Section F Other Direct Costs (categories)
rubrics_metrics.description: List Other Direct Costs under categories: Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, Alterations and Renovations, etc., and provide the Total Other Direct Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide line-item estimates for these categories and include any subaward budgets. Ensure totals roll up into 'Total Direct Costs (A thru F)'. Include documentation/attachments where required by the agency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Indirect Costs (Section H)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and specify the Cognizant Federal Agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate indirect costs based on the institution's negotiated rate and the appropriate base (e.g., Modified Total Direct Costs). Report the cognizant federal agency contact information where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Totals, Fee, and Reporting (Sections G–K)
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Total Direct Costs (G), Total Direct and Indirect Costs (I), Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H), and report any Fee (J) and other required fields; include Budget Justification attachments as indicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure all subtotals and totals are accurate and consistent across sections. Attach only one budget justification file where required and include agency contact, point of contact name/phone for subawards if requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Justification — personnel effort and responsibilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a narrative justification that describes each key person's role, percent effort (and equivalent months), relevant experience, responsibilities on the project, and justification for requested salary and effort.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples in the page: Patricia Garrett '60% effort (7.2 cm)' with paragraph describing experience and responsibilities; Andrew Levin '5% effort (0.6 cm)' describing tasks. Tie the narrative to the budgeted percent effort and tasks, and clarify institutional components (e.g., which tasks performed at which institution or subcontractor).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form metadata and organizational identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Include required form metadata fields such as Organizational DUNS, OMB Number and expiration date, Project Subaward/Consortium entries, Budget Period start/end dates, and Page numbering/header (e.g., 'PHS 398/2590 (Rev. 11/07)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The budget template displays OMB number 4040-0001 and expiration, prompts for organizational DUNS, and has controls for Budget Period attachments/entries. Ensure these administrative identifiers and form/version headers are present and accurate on submissions.
